cards.text: Jacob just tricked his father Isaac, who could no longer see, into giving him the blessing meant for his older brother Esau (Genesis 27:1-29). Now Esau is holding a grudge against Jacob because of that blessing. And Esau says something in his heart.

cards.question: Esau says in his heart that he will kill his brother Jacob. But first he's waiting for something. What is it?

answers.text: The days of mourning for his father
The end of the harvest season
The return of his hunting party

cards.text: Esau's words are relayed to Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.

cards.question: Rebekah sends for Jacob, warns him that Esau is plotting to kill him, and tells him to flee at once. To whom?
Rebekah tells Jacob to stay with Laban in Haran for a while, until Esau's ___ subsides.

cards.text: Jacob is to stay there until Esau's rage wanes and he forgets what Jacob did to him.

cards.question: True or false: Rebekah tells Jacob that once Esau's rage wanes, he'll have to find his own way home.

cards.text: Rebekah asks Jacob, "Why should I lose both of you in one day?" Then she goes to Isaac and tells him she is weary of her life.

cards.question: Rebekah tells Isaac she's weary of her life because of these ___ women.

cards.text: If Jacob takes a Hittite wife from among them, she says, what good is her life? Friend, Rebekah is not holding ANYTHING back.

cards.question: Isaac calls in Jacob, the son who came deceitfully and took Esau's blessing (Genesis 27:35). True or false: Isaac blesses Jacob.
Isaac gives Jacob a command about marriage. What is it?

answers.text: Don't marry until Esau forgives you
Marry before your mother sends for you

cards.text: Instead, Jacob is to go at once to Paddan-aram and marry one of the daughters of Laban, Rebekah's brother. Mom said RUN, Dad said find a WIFE, and somehow it's the SAME trip.

Then Isaac blesses him: "May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, so that you may become a company of peoples." One man heading out the door, and the blessing talks in WHOLE PEOPLES, friend.

cards.question: Isaac's blessing keeps going: may God give Jacob and his descendants the blessing of ___, Isaac's own father.
Isaac's blessing ends with something Jacob may possess. What is it?

answers.text: The land where he lives as a foreigner
The wells his father dug in Gerar
The flocks of his uncle Laban

cards.text: So Isaac sends Jacob off to Laban, and Jacob obeys. And Esau learns all of it: the blessing, the trip, and the command not to marry a Canaanite woman.

cards.question: Esau sees that his father Isaac disapproves of the Canaanite women. So who does Esau go to for a wife?
Esau marries Mahalath, the daughter of Abraham's son Ishmael. True or false: She replaces the wives Esau already had.

cards.text: Meanwhile Jacob leaves Beersheba and sets out for Haran. When the sun sets, he stops at a certain place, and congratulations, that spot is now the HOTEL.

cards.question: Jacob takes one of the ___ from that place and puts it under his head to sleep.
That night Jacob dreams about something resting on the earth, with its top reaching up to heaven. What is it?
In Jacob's dream, God's ___ are going up and down the ladder.

cards.text: And there at the top stands the LORD. He says, "I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac."

cards.question: The LORD makes Jacob a promise about the ground he's lying on. True or false: He will give that land to Jacob and his descendants.
The LORD says Jacob's descendants will be like the dust of the earth, spreading out west, east, north and south. True or false: He says only Jacob's own family will be blessed through him.
Jacob is headed far from home on this journey. What does the LORD promise him?

answers.text: To be with him and bring him back
To make the road short and easy
To soften Esau's heart right away

cards.text: Jacob wakes up and says, "Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it." Friend, that's a wake-up call LOUDER than any timer in my bakery.

cards.question: True or false: When Jacob wakes up and realizes the LORD is in that place, he feels completely calm.

cards.text: Then he says, "…This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven!" Friend, the man fell asleep on a ROCK and woke up calling that spot the GATE of heaven.

cards.question: Early the next morning, Jacob takes the stone he slept on. What does he do with it?

answers.text: Sets it up as a pillar and pours oil on it
Carries it with him all the way to Haran
Builds an altar and offers a sacrifice on it

cards.text: He calls that place Bethel, though the city used to be named Luz. The Millers, the family who took me home, carved my name into my handle, so trust me, friend, a NAME is a big deal.
Then Jacob makes a vow, and it starts with a big IF. If God will be with him and watch over him on this journey...

cards.question: Jacob's vow keeps going with another IF. If God will provide him with what?

answers.text: Food to eat and clothes to wear
Gold and silver for the road
Servants and camels for the trip

cards.text: All so he can return safely to his father's house. Then, Jacob says, the LORD will be his God, and that stone pillar will be God's house.

cards.question: Jacob promises that of all God gives him, he will surely give God a ___.

cards.text: Jacob still hasn't made it to Haran, friend. Stick with me, because his story is just getting warmed up, like an oven before the FIRST batch.
